errors_empty: No errors in this period. Browser and React errors appear after the first flush (≈10 seconds).
error_samples_empty: No stored samples for this issue in the period.
error_select_hint: Click a row to see the stack and context of samples.
vitals_empty: No Web Vitals yet. Browse the app — metrics are reported after interactions and page hide.
